PlaceOfListing.name: Place Of Listing
PlaceOfListing.definition: Market(s) on which the security is listed.

DayCountBasis.name: Day Count Basis
DayCountBasis.definition: Specifies the computation method of (accrued) interest of the security.

RegistrationForm.name: Registration Form
RegistrationForm.definition: Specifies the form, this is, ownership, of the security.

PaymentFrequency.name: Payment Frequency
PaymentFrequency.definition: Specifies the frequency of an interest payment.

PaymentStatus.name: Payment Status
PaymentStatus.definition: Status of payment of a security at a particular time.

VariableRateChangeFrequency.name: Variable Rate Change Frequency
VariableRateChangeFrequency.definition: Specifies the frequency of change to the variable rate of an interest bearing instrument.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification, for example, common share with voting rights, fully paid, or registered.

OptionStyle.name: Option Style
OptionStyle.definition: Specifies how an option can be exercised (American, European, Bermudan).

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies whether it is a Call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a Put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

DenominationCurrency.name: Denomination Currency
DenominationCurrency.definition: Currency in which a security is issued or redenominated.

CouponDate.name: Coupon Date
CouponDate.definition: Next payment date of an interest bearing financial instrument.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date on which a privilege expires.

FloatingRateFixingDate.name: Floating Rate Fixing Date
FloatingRateFixingDate.definition: Date at which the interest rate of an interest bearing security will be calculated and reset, according to the terms of the issue.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Planned final repayment date at the time of issuance.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date at which the security was made available.

NextCallableDate.name: Next Callable Date
NextCallableDate.definition: Next date at which the issuer has the right to pay the security prior to maturity.

PutableDate.name: Putable Date
PutableDate.definition: Date at which the holder has the right to ask for redemption of the security prior to final maturity.

DatedDate.name: Dated Date
DatedDate.definition: First date at which a security begins to accrue interest.

FirstPaymentDate.name: First Payment Date
FirstPaymentDate.definition: Date at which the first interest payment is due to holders of the security.

PreviousFactor.name: Previous Factor
PreviousFactor.definition: Rate expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 that was applicable before the current factor and defines the outstanding principal of the financial instrument (for factored securities).

CurrentFactor.name: Current Factor
CurrentFactor.definition: Rate expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 defining the outstanding principal of the financial instrument (for factored securities).

NextFactor.name: Next Factor
NextFactor.definition: Rate expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 that will be applicable as of the next factor date and defines the outstanding principal of the financial instrument (for factored securities).

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Per annum ratio of interest paid to the principal amount of the financial instrument for a specific period of time.

YieldToMaturityRate.name: Yield To Maturity Rate
YieldToMaturityRate.definition: Rate of return anticipated on a bond when held until maturity date.

NextInterestRate.name: Next Interest Rate
NextInterestRate.definition: Interest rate applicable to the next interest payment period in relation to variable rate instruments.

IndexRateBasis.name: Index Rate Basis
IndexRateBasis.definition: Specifies the reference rate for fixed income instruments where the |price of the instrument is indexed to the price of an underlying benchmark.

CouponAttachedNumber.name: Coupon Attached Number
CouponAttachedNumber.definition: Number of the coupon attached to the physical security.

PoolNumber.name: Pool Number
PoolNumber.definition: Number identifying a group of underlying assets assigned by the issuer of a factored security.

VariableRateIndicator.name: Variable Rate Indicator
VariableRateIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the interest rate of an interest bearing instrument is reset periodically.

CallableIndicator.name: Callable Indicator
CallableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the issuer has the right to pay the security prior to maturity. Also called RetractableIndicator.

PutableIndicator.name: Putable Indicator
PutableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the holder has the right to ask for redemption of the security prior to final maturity. Also called RedeemableIndicator.

MarketOrIndicativePrice.name: Market Or Indicative Price
MarketOrIndicativePrice.definition: Value of the price, for example, as a currency and value per unit or as a percentage.

ExercisePrice.name: Exercise Price
ExercisePrice.definition: Predetermined price at which the holder of a derivative will buy or sell the underlying instrument.

SubscriptionPrice.name: Subscription Price
SubscriptionPrice.definition: Pre-determined price at which the holder of a right is entitled to buy the underlying instrument.

ConversionPrice.name: Conversion Price
ConversionPrice.definition: Price of one target security in the conversion.

StrikePrice.name: Strike Price
StrikePrice.definition: Predetermined price at which the holder will have to buy or sell the underlying instrument.

MinimumNominalQuantity.name: Minimum Nominal Quantity
MinimumNominalQuantity.definition: Minimum nominal quantity of financial instrument.

ContractSize.name: Contract Size
ContractSize.definition: Ratio or multiplying factor used to convert one contract into a quantity.

FinancialInstrumentAttributeAdditionalDe.name: Financial Instrument Attribute Additional Details
FinancialInstrumentAttributeAdditionalDe.definition: Provides additional information about the financial instrument in narrative form.

PlaceOfListingRule.definition: If PlaceOfListing is used and a ISO 10383 MIC exists for the market to be identified, the ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) must be used.

AdditionalDetailsRule.definition: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if FinancialInstrumentAttributeAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.
